description: Cross-tree constraints linking transmission ecology to compartment evidence. Compiled to CNF for unit-propagation / DPLL. Independent of Phase 3; answers whether a Boolean feature assignment is SPL-consistent.

implies.rationale: Declaring a vector-borne route should be evidenced by mosquito/vector compartments or equivalent wording.
A vaccination compartment presupposes an immune/protected endpoint in the model flow.

Hospitalization stratification implies at least two infectious severity levels — disabled because acute-hospitalization models (COVID, Ebola, Influenza) commonly have hospitalized compartments without a staged chronic-progression structure.
ART/treatment compartments typically sit on a staged natural history (HIV progression, TB treatment phases).
If a zoonotic reservoir compartment is modelled, a non-human host species is necessarily present.
Spatial patch models almost always also stratify the population in some way.

mutex.rationale: Soft mutex: many models use vector OR general zoonotic framing as the primary route, not both simultaneously.
